concepts.name: Semantic Control Plane
concepts.what: The system of record for what things mean enterprise-wide.
concepts.why: Stops every team inventing its own definition of Customer, Product, or Service.
concepts.example: SID Customer is certified once in global/ and reused across DE/AT/HR/HU/PL and products.

concepts.name: Namespaces (global / natco-*)
concepts.what: Scopes for global vs local meaning — without forking the SID backbone.
concepts.why: Germany can keep “Kunde” locally while reporting still rolls up to Customer.

concepts.name: Semantic Registry
concepts.what: The catalog of certified concepts with stable URIs and lifecycle status.
concepts.why: Marketplace and AI only trust approved meaning — not draft labels.
concepts.example: URI …/global/customer · status approved · SID Customer ABE

concepts.name: Ontology & Taxonomy
concepts.what: How concepts relate and classify (hierarchies, types, predicates).
concepts.why: Makes “Customer owns Account” an explicit, reusable rule — not tribal knowledge.
concepts.example: Customer specializes PartyRole; Product realizedAs CustomerFacingService

concepts.name: Knowledge / Context Graph
concepts.what: The connected map from tables and terms to products, policies, and AI memory.
concepts.why: One place to answer: what is this column, who owns it, which product uses it?
concepts.example: Customer 360 table → customer_id → PII → SID Customer Identifier → product

concepts.name: Mapping Engine
concepts.what: Bridges glossary terms, technical assets, and products to enterprise concepts.
concepts.why: Collibra “Kunde” and crm.customer both resolve to the same SID Customer.
concepts.example: Kunde mapsTo Customer · crm.customer represents Customer

concepts.name: Federation Engine
concepts.what: Aligns NATCO meaning to global with typed links (sameAs, extends, …).
concepts.why: Cross-NATCO reporting and Global Marketplace stay coherent.
concepts.example: Kunden sameAs Customer; Kundenkonto extends Customer Account

concepts.name: Governance Engine
concepts.what: Approval, policy, and audit so only certified meaning is consumable.
concepts.why: No silent edits to “Customer”; product gates wait for approved concepts.
concepts.example: Customer: draft → review → approved before product binds

concepts.name: Semantic / Graph / MCP APIs
concepts.what: How Marketplace, BI, and AI agents look up, traverse, and ground on meaning.
concepts.why: Headless delivery — one meaning backbone, many consumers.
concepts.example: Resolve “Kunde” → global/customer; Graph neighbors for Customer 360

concepts.name: Apache OSSIE
concepts.what: Package import/export for partners and NATCOs — interchange only.
concepts.why: Share certified models without creating a second source of truth.
concepts.example: Export global Customer slice as a versioned semantic package

concepts.name: Entropy Marketplace
concepts.what: Where users discover data products enriched by enterprise meaning.
concepts.why: Products stay owned in Marketplace; meaning is certified in the control plane.
concepts.example: global-customer-360 implements SID Customer + Customer Account
